title: Quaint Flaky Ukrainian Gouda Cheese Dumplings
description: A funky and flaky Ukrainian dish featuring Gouda cheese, perfect for a date night, and vegetarian friendly. This recipe uses a spherification technique to create a unique and delicious experience.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, egg, sour cream, salt, and pepper, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a tablespoon of Gouda cheese in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the cheese and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and carefully add the dumplings to the pot.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
While the dumplings are cooking, heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Remove the dumplings from the pot and add them to the skillet, frying until golden brown on both sides.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
